Comedian and commentator Dave Smith joins Tucker Carlson for a talk on feuds inside the right. The title names his debate with Douglas Murray, the woke right label, and the moment Smith says he found God. Smith speaks as a libertarian voice.

Smith tells how the debate with Murray went and why the woke right tag angers him. He argues the right is split over war, Israel, and free speech. Carlson draws out his late turn toward faith. Listeners get a clear map of one loud fight on the right, from a man in the middle of it.
